policy.definition: Group a working paper, preprint and journal article as one study only after their version relationship is verified. Similar titles alone do not establish equivalence.
policy.case_verification: AI-assisted source inspection; the author authorized the convention, not the individual judgments.
policy.age_convention: Use the verified year of the version actually cited in each original entry; preserve final-publication metadata separately.
